rules.boundary_rules: Side-facing windows should be obscure glazed and non-opening below 1.7m, and rooflights or dormers that look directly into neighbouring rooms or gardens can still create overlooking issues.
rules.roof_rules: The dormer must not sit on the principal roof slope facing a highway. Apart from a hip-to-gable alteration, it should be set back at least 20cm from the eaves and should not include a balcony or roof terrace.
rules.materials_rules: External materials should be similar in appearance to the existing house so the roof works read as part of the original building rather than a bolt-on addition.
